data.overview: A plugin-only multi-agent reliability harness that stops physical-world referential drift. Establish one canonical emem:entity: identity, verify every downstream agent handoff, block wrong-object token switches, downgrade ambiguous phrase-only references, and optionally pass a signed evidence bundle with verified receipt. Includes live sample scenarios, a human Referent Lock panel, and stable JSON outputs for integration.
data.readme:
1. Install the emem plugin from the Dify Marketplace.
2. Import referent_lock_studio.yml.
3. Repair Tool bindings to the installed emem plugin if Dify asks.
4. Run Locked token handoff — Golden Gate Bridge in core mode.
5. Confirm REFERENT_LOCKED and one canonical emem:entity: token across Agent B and Agent C.
6. Run Injected wrong-object token — Bay Bridge; confirm REFERENTIAL_DRIFT_DETECTED.
7. Switch the locked scenario to showcase to add a signed physical evidence bundle, receiver-side resolution, and receipt verification.
8. For your own system choose Custom harness, or use referent_lock_api.yml and pass the canonical JSON contract.
9. In production, pass entity tokens between agents; do not rely on prose-only re-resolution or automatically register aliases.
